acceptance_policy: POI, centre points, compound/site polygons, metadata-only records and inferred uses are not accepted as buildings.
data_date: dataset metadata revision 2025-10-16; advertised daily update frequency; no feature-payload date obtained

field_evidence.footprint: NOT_PROVEN. The current official DRL states these building asset types are displayed in AIMS OM as a point at the centre of the structure. The service title 'Building Compounds' does not by itself prove that any service geometry is the true building footprint.
field_evidence.record_payload: No <=50 feature payload bytes were obtained from the attempted bbox query.
field_evidence.type_use: Official AIMS Building Compounds metadata lists building sub-types including Pump House, Office, Workshop, Gauge House, Garage, Residential and Boat Shed. Current DRL also defines Pump House, Office Building and Residential Building by actual/predominant use.

source_window_type: official public no-login FeatureServer service with one attempted Exeter/Devon bbox query
